name: zclass_world_set_virtual_area_partition
description: zClass_World::gwWorldSetVirtualAreaPartition configures world partition cell metrics, allocates the virtual area grid, initializes cell bounds and bounding spheres, and frees any previous grid first.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450c60 validates the previous-grid FreeVirtualAreaPartitions call, cell size/tolerance/half/inverse fields, areaCellRadiusBias float-bit approximation, signed row/column count rounding, row-table and row calloc sizes, per-cell 0x100 area flag, cell min coordinates, signed-Z bbox orientation, BBox::MinMaxToBoundingSphere call, areaIndex -1, and return 0.

The native smoke verifies negative-Z partition setup, row/column counts, cell metric fields, exact radius-bias bits, representative cell bbox/center initialization, and cleanup through FreeVirtualAreaPartitions.
